description: Ontotext, doing business as Graphwise, is looking for Senior Java Backend Engineer. We need your expertise to help us build great knowledge graph products. Our main development offices are in Sofia, Vienna and Ruse If you are interested in technology and working in a close-knit, dynamic environment, Graphwise might be the right fit for you!
